extensions.checkpoint_semantics: Actual canonical S3 gate mandatory; no in-row restore; retries use fresh directories and do not retain clock validity.

inadmissible: Target generation before committed exact source, prospective freeze, actual S3 gate and explicit root release.
Drawing scalar labels or replacing targets after coincidences/failure.
Using B2 results as preprocessing or stopping the census after recovery.
Requiring full base rank before checking natural target recovery.
Duplicating integrated oracle counts/resources or claiming complete S/attack speed from partial costs.
invalidation_rules: Source/input change, nonfullEC1 hash identity, scalar label, altered preprocessing or failed complete replay prevents verified observation.
Missing or interrupted targets remain unknown; no regenerated replacements after coincidences.
No performance claim or complete-cost inference from partial producer counters.
